Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Imaging findings include EITHER of the following at the requested level(s): dynamic segmental instability on flexion-extension plain x-rays OR comparison of a supine and upright image, with a difference in translational alignment between vertebrae >3mm between views
Meyerding Grade II or higher spondylolisthesis
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)
provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)

Required findings: Imaging findings include ANY of the following at the requested level(s): Meyerding Grade I or II spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) and plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis
Meyerding Grade III or higher spondylolisthesis (anterolisthesis) with ≥50% anterior slippage OR plain x-rays support progression of anterolisthesis
progressive spinal pain without confirmatory imaging showing progression of spondylolisthesis
multi-level spondylolysis on plain x-rays
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)
provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)

Medical necessity indications.Guideline Category: Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease
Required findings: Plain x-rays and advanced imaging (i.e., CT, MRI) show moderate to severe singlelevel disc degeneration at the requested level(s).
Presence of chronic, unremitting, discogenic axial lower back pain and associated disability secondary to single-level degenerative lumbar disc disease (DDD) for at least one year
Symptoms include significant level of pain on a daily basis defined as clinically significant functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing, etc.)
Structured physician-supervised, multi-modal, nonoperative management of medical care with licensed healthcare professionals which includes ALL of the following:
regularly scheduled appointments
follow-up evaluation

less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for at least 12 consecutive months
provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician) for at least 12 consecutive months
epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s) as the requested surgery
facet joint injection(s)/medial branch block(s)/radiofrequency ablation(s)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Discogenic Lower Back Pain/Degenerative Disc Disease

Required findings: Imaging findings include EITHER of the following:
coronal plane deformity which includes ANY of the following: Cobb angle >30°
asymmetric disk collapse causing symptomatic foraminal narrowing
global coronal imbalance causing head and trunk shift off the midline
sagittal imbalance which includes ANY of the following: sagittal vertebral axis measurement >8cm
pelvic incidence-lumbar lordosis >15°

Less than clinically meaningful improvement with EITHER of the following (unless contraindicated) for at least three (3) consecutive months: prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs)
provider-directed exercise program (prescribed by a physical therapist, chiropractic provider, osteopathic or allopathic physician)
Medical necessity indications.Source: CMM-609.5: Lumbar Fusion (Arthrodesis) without Decompression > Adult Symptomatic Degenerative Spinal Deformity

Non-Indications: Absence of unmanaged significant mental and/or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid and alcohol use disorders)

Documentation of nicotine-free status with EITHER of the following: individual is a never-smoker OR individual has refrained from smoking, use of smokeless tobacco products, and/ or nicotine replacement therapy for at least six (6) weeks prior to planned surgery validated by objective cotinine testing methods (serum, urinary, or saliva) verified as within the normal range for the testing method and lab at which the test was performed
